_about: Batch B5t (Plugin tours): tours/life-of-a-plugin, tours/build-a-toy-plugin. Owner: the B5t writer.

plugin-package.short: An installable Python package that publishes one or more vLLM entry points, for example a vendor package with a platform plugin and a general plugin.
plugin-package.long: vLLM's own test packages in {{cite tests/plugins/}} are small examples, for example {{cite tests/plugins/vllm_add_dummy_platform/setup.py:6-18}}.

entry-point-metadata.short: The file entry_points.txt in the .dist-info folder of an installed package. importlib.metadata reads it when vLLM asks for the entry points of a group.
entry-point-metadata.long: The installer writes it from entry_points= in setup.py or from the [project.entry-points."..."] tables in pyproject.toml ({{cite pyproject.toml:45-47}}).
